PARIS GOLF GALLERY CERAMIC ASHTRAYS

A series of 18 unique ceramic ashtrays, each one inspired by the shape of a golf hole.

products.title: Paris Golf Gallery x Nas Studio - Skin Break Perfume
products.body_html:
Golf is the new culture. Not because it got loud because it got chosen. By the right people. For the right reasons.

Scent did the same thing, a long time ago. Both are codes. Both say everything about who you are without asking permission. We put them together.

To create this fragrance, Alexandra Mettetal didn’t start with a formula, she started with a feeling. She spent time immersed in the world of golf: the texture of aged leather gloves, the silence before a swing, the dry heat rising from sand bunkers on a summer course.

Her process was tactile and instinctive. She wanted the scent to carry tension the kind you feel right before a decisive moment and then slowly release into something quieter, more mineral.

The result is a leather like no other.

Slice Town x Paris Golf Gallery - Remove Pitch
products.body_html:
A golf essential, reworked with a twist.

Created in collaboration with Slice Town, this limited-edition divot tool takes inspiration from the iconic butterfly knife mechanism, turning a classic piece of golf equipment into a playful, collectible object.

Designed to repair pitch marks on the green, the tool features a folding dual-handle construction with custom Slice Town × Paris Golf Gallery detailing.

Produced in a strictly limited run of 200 pieces, each divot tool is individually numbered from 001 to 200, making every piece unique to the series.

products.title: Pluto Golf x Paris Golf Gallery - Limited Edition Cap
products.body_html:
Built for the course, designed for everywhere else.

Created in collaboration with Pluto Golf, this limited-edition cap combines a technical outdoor construction with the visual language of Paris Golf Gallery.

The cap features a lightweight black ripstop-style technical fabric, paired with breathable mesh side panels for added ventilation. A system of contrasting white elastic cords wraps around both sides, giving the cap its distinctive technical silhouette while referencing outdoor and performance gear.

Finished with white embroidered graphics on the front and Paris Golf Gallery branding at the back, along with a contrasting white top button. An adjustable rear strap allows for a comfortable, personalized fit.

A functional golf accessory designed to move easily between the course and the city.

products.title: Odd Ritual x Paris Golf Gallery - SS27 Cap
products.body_html:
A classic golf cap with a vintage club feel.

Created in collaboration between Odd Ritual and Paris Golf Gallery, this cap draws inspiration from traditional golf clubs and vintage sportswear, reworked through the visual identity of both brands.

Built in a 6-panel cotton twill construction, the cap combines an off-white crown with a contrasting blue visor and top button. The front features a raised Odd Ritual Golf Club patch, while custom gold embroidery on the side highlights the Odd Ritual Golf Club × Paris Golf Gallery collaboration.

The silhouette and flat visor give the cap a relaxed, timeless shape. At the back, an adjustable strap with buckle allows for a personalized fit.

Designed for the course, the clubhouse, and everything after.

products.title: Paré x Paris Golf Gallery - Tour de Paré Cap
products.body_html:
A Tour de France-inspired golf cap made for the course and beyond.

Created in collaboration between Paré Golf and Paris Golf Gallery, “Le Tour de Paré” cap plays with the codes of golf, Paris and vintage sportswear through a clean, understated silhouette.

The cap comes in a warm cream colorway, constructed from a lightweight, smooth technical-style fabric for a comfortable everyday feel. Its classic multi-panel construction is finished with embroidered ventilation eyelets and a flat visor for a relaxed, retro-inspired fit.

The front features the custom “Le Tour de Paré” artwork embroidered in navy and orange, while the side carries the Paris Golf Gallery signature embroidery in navy. Tonal stitching throughout keeps the construction clean and lets the graphics stand out.

At the back, an adjustable snapback closure makes for an easy, personalized fit.

A playful meeting point between Parisian culture and golf, designed for the fairway, the clubhouse and the city.

products.title: PXG x Paris Golf Gallery - Color Cap

An exclusive collaboration between PXG and Paris Golf Gallery, blending performance golf aesthetics with contemporary style.

Featuring a structured crown, curved visor, embroidered ventilation eyelets and bold PXG branding, complemented by Paris Golf Gallery embroidery on the side.

Available in Black, Yellow and White, each colorway features contrasting embroidered and dimensional logo details.

Paris Golf Gallery - Palo Santo
products.body_html:
Bring a little Golf Energy into your home.

This special edition Paris Golf Gallery Palo Santo includes 4 sticks of 100% natural Palo Santo wood from Ecuador, ethically sourced from naturally fallen trees and handcrafted by local communities.

Traditionally used for its warm, woody aroma and cleansing ritual, Palo Santo is ideal for creating a calm, relaxing atmosphere at home. Light the stick, let it burn briefly, then blow out the flame and allow the glowing ember to release its aromatic smoke.

Inspired by the ritual before the perfect swing: focus, purify, reset.
